rationale: The requirement fixes one structural obligation: the `read_node` tool's description must be the quoted text. `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tools.rs#impl[GraphSession<'_, '_, D>/Conversation]/fn[tools]` builds the `read_node` definition with `"description":"Read a known graph node. Returns text and, when more remains, a next UUID. A delivered page records its enclosing node."`. That string matches the required text word for word. The definition is deserialized into a `ToolDefinition` and returned in the tool list. The parent `read_node.mcp` requirement sets the tool name and the `path` parameter. The same item supplies both, with a `path` object whose `segments` is an array of strings. This requirement adds nothing beyond the description. It has no refining declarations and no {fixme} acknowledgments, and I found no structural gap.
